sentences.en: The library has open shelves where you can browse books freely.
sentences.zh: 图书馆里有开放书架，你可以自由浏览书籍。

sentences.en: Our kitchen features open shelves for easy access to everyday items.
sentences.zh: 我们的厨房设有开放书架，方便日常用品的取用。

sentences.en: The bookstore uses open shelves to display new releases prominently.
sentences.zh: 这家书店使用开放书架来突出展示新出版的书籍。
